name: web-violet-marketplace-filter-sidebar-product-grid
title: Violet Marketplace with Filter Sidebar
whatItIs: A rounded desktop window on a violet gradient with a search header, pill category tabs, a left filter sidebar (price histogram, stars, brands, delivery) and a grid of product cards, one highlighted as a purple photo card.
whatItMeans: A single violet accent on soft grey cards feels modern and friendly, and the histogram slider shows detail without heaviness.
techniques: Price slider over a mini histogram
Pill tabs for categories with one filled
One product card inverted with a full-bleed photo and rating chips
Cutout product photos on pale gray tiles

vocabulary.definition: A range slider drawn over a bar chart of the value distribution.
A product card styled differently to stand out.
Rounded tab buttons for switching category.
